statement: (i) Prove that $\\cos A+\\cos B=2\\cos\\frac{A+B}{2}\\cos\\frac{A-B}{2}$. (ii) Hence find the exact value of $\\cos 75^{\\circ}+\\cos 15^{\\circ}$.
solution: (i) Using $\\cos u+\\cos v=2\\cos((u+v)/2)\\cos((u-v)/2)$ with $u=A,v=B$ gives the result. (ii) $\\cos75^{\\circ}+\\cos15^{\\circ}=2\\cos45^{\\circ}\\cos30^{\\circ}=2\\cdot\\frac{\\sqrt{2}}{2}\\cdot\\frac{\\sqrt{3}}{2}=\\frac{\\sqrt{6}}{2}$.
